headline: Sensex gains over 400 points and Nifty crosses 25,200 driven by foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows boosted market sentiment in early trade.
Lower global crude oil prices provided support to the domestic equity benchmarks.
Rally in heavyweights including Asian Paints, Bharti Airtel, and ITC lifted Nifty and Sensex.
Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman held pre-budget consultations with economists ahead of Budget 2027.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 400 points while Nifty 50 traded comfortably above the 25,200 level.
Max Health gained 6% while Inox Wind shares slipped 9% in morning trading.
Baazar Style shares hit a 52-week high following strong buying interest.
Supreme Court upheld NCLAT's ruling on Videocon's ₹2,962-crore resolution plan.
summary:
Indian stock markets opened higher on November 16, 2026, supported by foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices.
Sensex gained over 400 points while Nifty moved past 25,200, led by Asian Paints, Bharti Airtel, and ITC.
Major stock movers included Max Health gaining 6% and Baazar Style touching a 52-week high, whereas Inox Wind dropped 9%.
